entries.voice.GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.tip: Count two seconds past a signpost behind the car ahead.
entries.voice.GB.GAP.WET_ICY.tip: Double your following gap in rain and tenfold on ice.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.BOX.tip: Wait behind the box until space opens on the far side.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.tip: Slow down early and stop if main-road traffic is close.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.tip: Check the pavement before turning and let waiting pedestrians cross.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.tip: Bring your wheels to a full stop at the solid line.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.tip: Wait until oncoming traffic is far enough away before turning right.
entries.voice.GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.tip: Check your left mirror for cyclists before turning left.
entries.voice.GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.tip: Check mirrors, glance at your blind spot, then signal and move.
entries.voice.GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.tip: Return to the left lane as soon as overtaking is complete.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.tip: Check overhead signs early and pick your lane before the roundabout.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.tip: Look right early and wait for a safe roundabout gap.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.tip: Signal left for left turns and right for turns past twelve o'clock.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.tip: Signal left right after passing the exit before your exit.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.tip: Follow the painted lane lines all the way around the roundabout.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.tip: Always steer left to travel clockwise around UK roundabouts.
entries.voice.GB.SCH.SLOW.tip: Ease off to twenty miles per hour past school warning signs.
entries.voice.GB.SIG.TIMELY.tip: Signal a few seconds before steering, then cancel once clear.
entries.voice.GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.tip: Slow down before you pass each lower speed limit sign.
entries.voice.GB.TL.AMBER.tip: Prepare to stop whenever traffic lights turn amber.
entries.voice.GB.TL.ASL.tip: Stop behind the first white line to leave the cycle box free.
entries.voice.GB.TL.RED.tip: Stop smoothly behind the solid white line on red.
entries.voice.GB.TL.RED_AMBER.tip: Keep your brakes on until the green light shows.
entries.voice.GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.tip: Wait behind the cyclist until you can leave 1.5 metres.
entries.voice.GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.tip: Turn on fog lights in thick fog, then turn off afterwards.
entries.voice.GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.tip: Drive slow enough to stop within the road you can see.
entries.voice.GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.tip: Switch on dipped headlights as soon as street lights come on.
entries.voice.GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.tip: Use dipped headlights and slow down in spray or mist.
entries.voice.GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.tip: Dip your headlights as soon as another vehicle comes into view.
entries.voice.GB.XNG.ZEBRA.tip: Stop behind the stripes whenever someone waits at a zebra crossing.
entries.voice.GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.tip: Never overtake any vehicle inside the crossing zig-zag zone.
